ops.title: consent relay-leg timeout failover can prompt a second peer while the first sheet is still up
ops.description:
Found in review of synckit PR #11 (minor, pre-existing, not changed by #11). `consent.Router.relay` routes around a relay leg that hits `RelayTimeout` (`rpc.DispatchTimeout - 30s`). The peer's own consent sheet stays up until its own deadline, about 30s later. So a timed-out leg moves to the next candidate while peer A's prompt may still be answered, and a denial or approval on A whose reply is lost is not terminal. Same class of hazard #11 cited against reviving 255 failover.

Decide: document the at-least-once edge in `consent/route.go` routesAround/Route godoc, or make the relay-leg timeout fatal too (fail-closed), or cancel the peer's sheet before advancing. Security-sensitive: route through two reviews.
